shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index went up by 41 points or 0.39 percent on Monday to close at 10692 points.The rise was led by The Sage Group (6.05%), Relx (5.43%) and GlaxoSmithKline (4.72%).On the downside, the weakerst performers were Antofagasta (-5.38%), Halma (-5.12%) and Weir (-4.33%).
